thread.title: All Dow stocks trading premarket are rising after jobs data

title: All Dow stocks trading premarket are rising after jobs data
text:
Published: Mar 9, 2018 8:54 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
Shares of the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +1.50% components turned broadly higher in premarket trade Friday, after the release of better-than-expected jobs data , with the only one of 30 stocks not rising because it was still inactive. Dow futures YMH8, +1.46% surged 159 points, after trading slightly lower ahead of the data. Among the biggest gainers, shares of J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. JPM, +2.60% rallied 1.1%, Caterpillar Inc. CAT, +2.68% climbed 1.0%, Boeing Co. BA, +1.58% advanced 1.0% and Intel Corp. INTC, +2.99% rose 0.9%. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +1.28% which tacked on 0.6%. Travelers Companies Inc.'s stock TRV, +1.37% was still inactive. Quote References
